About us

VOF was founded in Al Ghubrah in 2022 by a young couple with a simple vision: a gym where people feel stronger, healthier and more confident, inside the gym and out.

What began as a shared passion for fitness has grown into a community built on discipline, consistency, respect and personal growth. Whether it's your first workout or you're chasing a big goal, you'll find the support to get there, and everyone is welcome.

Train with purpose. Stay consistent. Grow together.

Not sure where to start? Just ask.

Building muscle, losing weight or getting fitter, tell the trainers your goal and they'll help you get there.

Questions, answered

Are trainers really included in the membership?

Yes. Every membership includes guidance from our trainers, including workout plans, diet guidance and form checks. There's no extra fee.

Do the trainers help with diet?

Yes. Along with your workouts, our trainers can guide you on what to eat to match your goal, whether that's building muscle, losing fat or getting fitter.

What are the opening hours?

Open 7 days a week. Saturday to Thursday, 5:00am to 2:00am. Friday, 4:00pm to 10:00pm.

Is the gym mixed?

Yes. The gym is open to everyone during all opening hours.

What equipment do you have?

Free weights and racks, strength machines, cardio equipment including treadmills and bikes, and a functional turf area.

Do you have lockers and washrooms?

Yes, both are available to all members.

Which memberships can I choose from?

1 month for 15 OMR, a 2-month student offer for 20 OMR, 3 months for 30 OMR, 6 months for 40 OMR, and a year for 55 OMR with an extra month free. Prices exclude 5% VAT. Every plan includes the same access, trainer guidance and free cardio classes.

Are you opening another location?

Yes, a second VOF is coming soon. Follow us on Instagram for the announcement.
